Court No. - 69

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 56443 of 2019
Applicant :- Israfil

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Sharma,Abhas Sharma,Ayush Dwivedi,Naushad Alam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Subhash Chandra Yadav
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
List revised.

2. Heard Sri Shashi Kant Dwivedi, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Naushad Alam, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajay Singh, learned AGA for the State and perused the material on record.
3.
Learned A.G.A. has filed counter affidavit of the State today in Court which is taken on record.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant states that he does not want to file any response to the counter affidavit of the State.

1
5. Sri Subhash Chandra Yadav, learned counsel for the first informant is not present even in the revised list.

6. This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant Israfil, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No.
406/2019 under Sections 498A, 304B, 328 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, registered at P.S. Masoori,
District Ghaziabad.

7. The First Information Report of the present case was lodged on 09.6.2019 by Smt. Shahzadi against the applicant alleging therein that marriage of the applicant was solemnized with her daughter Shabiha on 19.1.2019.
After marriage things went well but after sometimes there was demand of dowry by the applicant.
He used to torture her.
On 07.6.2019 at about 12:30 pm when the applicant was torturing her a lot she asked her on phone to come otherwise he may kill her.
Later on she came to know that her daughter was thrown from second floor of the house and she has died.
8. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that although the applicant is husband of the deceased but he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is argued that the deceased died a natural death.
It is argued that the doctor conducting post mortem examination although found two multiple abraded contusion and one laceration on her body but did not find any internal injury.
It is argued that cause of death could not ascertained and hence viscera was preserved.
It is further argued that viscera after examination was found not to be containing any chemical poison in it and as such there is nothing on record to show that the deceased died as unnatural death.

Further it is argued that in so far as the alleged demand of dowry is concerned, even the same is vague inasmuch as the first informant has not stated in the F.I.R. as to what was the specific demand of dowry by the applicant.
It is argued that prior to the present incident there is no complaint whatsoever of the applicant torturing the deceased.
It is argued that the applicant is having no criminal history as stated in para-15 of the affidavit and is in jail since 12.6.2019.
9. Per contra, learned State counsel opposed the prayer for bail and it is argued that the applicant is husband of the deceased.
The deceased died an unnatural death in her matrimonial house within six months of her marriage.
It is argued that thus the prayer for bail be rejected.

10. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that although the applicant is husband of the deceased but as per post mortem report cause of death could not ascertained and viscera was preserved but in the viscera report no chemical poison was found.
The F.I.R. remains vague in so far as the specific demand of dowry is concerned.
The applicant has remained in jail for more than four years.

11. Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence and also the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence, this Court is of the view that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

2 12.

Let the applicant- Israfil, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties (out of which one surety should be the family member of the applicant and the other should be a local person) each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
ii) The applicant will abide the orders of court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.
(V) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law and the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC.

(vi) The trial court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously after the release of the applicant.
13. The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
14. The bail application is allowed.
( Samit
Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 18.7.2023
